gold_sql: SELECT T1.account_id FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993' AND T1.duration = 12 ORDER BY T1.amount DESC LIMIT 1
